g.text: AICS Request Management & Beneficiary Information System • Municipality of Daanbantayan, Cebu

g.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.data-desc: The entry point for residents seeking municipal social assistance under the AICS Program in Daanbantayan.
Resident provides Full Name, Email, Password (8+ chars, upper, lower, number, special), accepts Terms & Conditions, and completes 6-digit OTP verification. Profile is created with is_active = false.
g.text: Sign Up, Agree to Terms & Verify OTP

g.data-desc: Admin reviews newly registered resident profile and confirms residency in Barangay Pajo before toggling is_active = true. Unapproved accounts cannot proceed.
Resident is redirected to /pending screen awaiting MSWDO Admin activation. Real-time polling/listening alerts the resident once their profile is verified.
Authenticated and approved resident logs into the portal. Dashboard inspects if the resident has an existing beneficiary registry record linked to their auth ID.
System queries beneficiaries table where created_by == auth.uid(). If null, AICS request creation is locked and user is directed to the registration form.
Resident fills demographic registry: Full Name, Birthdate, Sex, Civil Status, Purok in Barangay Pajo, 11-digit Contact (09XXXXXXXXX), Monthly Income, Occupation, Family Size, and PWD/Senior/4Ps tags.
Beneficiary master record is inserted into database with audit action CREATE_BENEFICIARY. Dashboard capability is instantly unlocked.
Enforces strict municipal anti-duplication policy: Checks if resident has an existing request in 'Pending' or 'Approved' status, or a recently closed grant within the 30-day restriction window.
User is prevented from filing multiple simultaneous assistance claims. Logs BLOCKED_DUPLICATE_REQUEST in immutable audit trail.
Resident selects the municipal assistance category. Medical assistance covers hospitalization and medicines; Burial assistance covers funeral services and casket expenses.
Beneficiary completes medical details: Hospital/Clinic Name, Official Diagnosis, Estimated Cost (PHP), Purpose of Request, and Amount Range (₱1,000 - ₱10,000).
Checklist of required crisis proofs: (1) Medical Certificate / Clinical Abstract, (2) Hospital Bill / Official Quotation, (3) Doctor Prescription, (4) Barangay Certificate of Indigency.

Beneficiary completes burial details: Deceased Full Name (First, Middle, Last, Suffix), Relationship to Beneficiary, Searchable Funeral Home (Bogo to Daanbantayan), and Amount Range (₱5,000 - ₱10,001+).
Checklist of required crisis proofs: (1) Official Certified Death Certificate, (2) Signed Funeral Contract, (3) Barangay Certificate of Indigency.
Resident captures or uploads Front Side and Back Side photos of their Valid Government ID. File upload or live camera captures are validated for image type and file size (< 10 MB).
Application is inserted into requests table with status 'Pending'. Files are securely uploaded to Supabase Storage bucket 'documents'. Activity is logged in system_logs.
Consolidated electronic docket containing resident personal data, crisis rationale, ID photos, and uploaded certificates available to social workers.
Licensed social worker evaluates indigency, case history, and documents. Admin issues decision: Approve (determines PHP grant) or Decline (provides mandatory written justification).
Request status is set to 'Declined'. Beneficiary receives instant notification and can view official MSWDO caseworker remarks directly in their tracking timeline.
Request status becomes 'Approved' with release_status 'Pending Release'. Approved grant amount (PHP) is pre-encumbered against the municipal assistance budget pool.
Municipal Treasurer validates liquid balance, prepares official Disbursement Voucher (DV-YYYY-XXXX), and confirms readiness. Request transitions to 'Ready for Release'.
Beneficiary or authorized representative visits Municipal Treasury with original valid ID, signs official payroll/acknowledgment receipt, and receives cash grant.
Treasurer logs disbursement. Backend atomically deducts fund balance, updates request to 'Released', and issues payout receipt. Beneficiary receives completion notice.
